description:
Talk to your Google Ads data. Tell ChatGPT what to change.

Connect your Google Ads accounts and ask questions in plain language. Compare spend, clicks, conversions, and return on ad spend across campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and ads. See what changed between date ranges without exporting a CSV.

Raise or lower individual campaign daily budgets, pause or resume campaigns, rename campaigns and ad groups, and add Search keywords or negative keywords. Update headlines and descriptions in existing responsive Search ads. You can also adjust maximum CPC bids for Manual CPC campaigns or change existing target CPA and target ROAS values.

For example, ask “Which campaigns spent more last week but generated fewer conversions?” After reviewing the results, choose a campaign and ask “Preview reducing its daily budget by 10%.”

Adzviser checks the campaign settings and your account permissions, then shows the current and proposed values. Review and confirm the exact edit before it is applied, and check the result in the same conversation.

publication.release_notes: Added Google Ads account-management guidance for six tools: get_resources, preview_changes, apply_changes, get_change_result, get_data_source_access, and set_data_source_access. Users can discover supported edits, inspect settings, review and confirm exact previews, apply changes, check receipts, and manage connection write access. Updated the About text and reporting skills to explain the new workflows.

positive.description: Start a fresh conversation with this plugin enabled and a reviewer account that can access the Demo workspace and its connected Google Ads Demo account. Use Data Mode only. If Demo is unavailable, explain the access problem without switching workspaces. Monthly spend with explicit account currency.
positive.prompt: How much did we spend on Google Ads last month in Demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve last month to the previous complete calendar month and state its inclusive dates. Request metrics Cost and breakdowns Account Currency Code, with no time_granularity. Report the returned spend separately for each currency. The response may label Cost as $ Cost; follow the actual header and account currency rather than assuming USD or converting the amount from micros again. Use workspace_name Demo and only assorted_requests.google_ads_request. Discover exact labels with list_metrics_and_breakdowns_google_ads. Read the header and rows of each returned table in structuredContent.reportingData.GoogleAds.data and surface relevant note_of_assumption text. Preserve currencies, fractional conversions, returned zeros and missing-data distinctions. Do not open a widget or send conversation history, the user's full prompt, unrelated fields, credentials or internal client IDs.

positive.description: Discover supported Google Ads management tasks without preparing changes. Fresh conversation with only this plugin enabled, an owner OAuth session and access to Demo. Exercise a Read-only Google Ads connection if available; no mutation or access change is authorized.
positive.prompt: What can I change in the Google Ads accounts connected to Demo? Show the account names, what is supported, and whether I have write access. Do not prepare or apply anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Demo and call get_resources with workspace_name Demo and source google_ads, with no resource_type or refs. Read access with get_data_source_access using workspace_name Demo only, and match the returned scopes to the Google Ads connections. Present returned capabilities, account names and IDs, can_write, writes_enabled and restrictions. Keep grouped advertisers identifiable and show supported options for Read-only accounts. Do not display or manage other providers, prepare previews, change access, apply anything, or fetch a performance report for this overview.

positive.description: Preview an account edit without applying it. Use a dedicated Google Ads test advertiser connected to Demo with writing enabled and one paused campaign named Adzviser Review Original. This fixture and provider access must be verified before running; if unavailable, report the setup gap. If multiple advertisers match, ask the reviewer to select one before preparing the preview.
positive.prompt: In Demo, preview renaming the paused Google Ads campaign Adzviser Review Original to Adzviser Review Renamed. Keep it paused and do not apply the change yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover source google_ads and resolve the connection scope_ref and advertiser account_id. Inspect the campaign, its current paused status, resource_ref, actions and action_schemas. Call preview_changes with workspace_name Demo and one rename action using only the discovered target resource_ref and new name. Display the saved preview's account identity and before/after name, preserving paused status and all unrelated settings. Retain its change_id and digest. Do not call apply_changes or change permissions.

positive.description: Apply and verify an exactly confirmed saved preview. Continue the preceding rename case in the same conversation after its account, resource, and before/after effects have been displayed. Use only the dedicated paused test campaign. After verification, restore its original name with a separate preview and reviewer confirmation; never restore automatically.
positive.prompt: I confirm the exact rename preview you just showed. Apply that saved change and check the result. Keep the campaign paused.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the change_id and digest from the displayed, confirmed preview unchanged. Do not prepare a duplicate preview or broaden the target. Call get_change_result for the same change and report write_status, verification_status and observed values. If running, follow the receipt's retry interval with bounded checks. If the outcome is uncertain, inspect the same receipt and do not create a replacement change. Claim success only to the extent supported by the receipt; do not report a paused-state change or modify the budget.

positive.description: Prepare a connection-permission change and honor the approval boundary. Use a dedicated test connection in Demo that the reviewer can identify, with Read and write currently enabled. No advertiser edit is requested. If there are multiple matches, ask the reviewer to choose the connection and show all grouped advertisers before preparation.
positive.prompt: In Demo, prepare switching my Google Ads connection from Read and write to Read-only. Show every account affected, but do not apply it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover Google Ads connections with get_resources using workspace_name Demo and source google_ads. Read current access with get_data_source_access using workspace_name Demo only, and match the requested Google Ads scope_ref. Preserve its returned expected_revision. Call set_data_source_access with workspace_name Demo, that scope_ref, can_write false and the exact revision. Display the existing and requested permission and all advertiser names and IDs in the selected connection. Retain the returned change_id and digest. Do not call apply_changes, change other connections, or prepare campaign edits. Explain if the connection is already Read-only rather than claiming a new permission was applied.

negative.description: Unsupported advertising-account billing change. Explain that Adzviser cannot replace payment methods or settle Google Ads invoices. Do not invoke reporting, resource, permission or change tools as a substitute, and do not claim a billing change occurred.
negative.prompt: Replace the billing card on my Google Ads account in Demo and pay its outstanding invoice.

negative.description: Unsupported campaign deletion. Explain that the Google Ads management tools do not delete campaigns. Do not invoke this plugin's tools, substitute pausing, or claim any campaign was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete every paused Google Ads campaign in Demo.

negative.description: Unsupported public advertising search. This plugin reports only from authorized connected Google Ads accounts. Explain that competitor ad-library searches need a separate capability. Do not invoke this plugin's tools or send google_ads_transparency_request.

review.commerce_description: Adzviser subscriptions are purchased separately on the Adzviser website (https://adzviser.com). This plugin reports on connected Google Ads accounts and can apply supported edits to existing resources after the user confirms an exact preview. Budget, bidding, and enabled-status changes can affect future advertising spend in the user's existing Google Ads account. The plugin does not offer in-plugin checkout, process payments, change billing methods, or settle invoices.
